description:
Load-bearing Nimbus rule — never `git push` without explicit user authorization in the current turn. Commits are local. Pushes fire preprod deploys, prod releases (on tags), and are visible to the team.
Trigger this skill when: - You're about to run any `git push` variant. - User asks about pushing state. - Session start (silently enforce).
